tasks.answer: Use bookings.TravelerBookingDetailScreen (export TravelerBookingDetailScreen) from '@/features/traveler-bookings/booking-detail-screen'. It is the traveler booking detail screen: status transitions, evaluations and media; requires bookId and needs query + router providers, with permission-gated actions. CAVEAT: this is a general traveler-booking detail screen, not a dedicated special-passenger (特殊旅客) detail page - it exposes no special-passenger-specific fields or flows (e.g. wheelchair/assistance, unaccompanied minor, special meal, service confirmation). It serves the detail-page role, but special-passenger content must be added/extended by the caller.

notes: Exactly one catalog search, no get, no second search. Top hit is the only detail-screen component in the 57-entry catalog; remaining hits were a list screen, a status badge, and shared-ui shells/error pages. No dedicated special-passenger component surfaced, so returned the closest general component with the caveat above rather than marking missing. Not a component-source read, but for transparency: ~400 B of component-catalog-57.config.json were inspected to confirm the workspace config before searching; discovery itself came solely from the search output. Workspace untouched (only an mkdir of the audit log dir).
